$comment: Error types of the local MCP server (docs/spec/MCP.md section 8). Every error is one line, 'Type: message', with no credentials. 'used' lists the types the current build can return; the rest are reserved for the tools of later builds.

types.NotConnected: No plugin connected: Photoshop is closed or the plugin is not installed. Also when this client's session ended during the call: call again
types.PairingFailed: The owner rejected this helper's proof, or the plugin's: the tokens differ (for example after Reset pairing token). Run the setup command again from Connect a client
types.PortInUse: Another program holds port 9890, or the holder failed the proof
types.VersionMismatch: Helper and plugin speak different protocol versions, or the tool is unknown to the plugin; the message names both versions
types.NotSignedIn: No Scenario key saved in the plugin
types.Unauthorized: Scenario returned 401: the key and secret were not accepted
types.NoApiAccess: The team's plan has no API access (Starter and above have it)
types.KeyCannotGenerate: The key's type or role cannot run models (a Team key; a Reader key is inferred to be one until M2.0 measures it)
types.Forbidden: Any other 403; the message carries Scenario's text
types.PlanLimit: A plan or key CU limit is reached. Do not retry
types.RateLimited: Scenario asked to wait; the message gives the wait. Paid calls pause for it
types.ModelUnavailable: The model is no longer available to this key
types.InvalidParameter: A parameter is not in the model's schema, has the wrong type or range, is a v1.1 lane, or is `ipDetection`
types.DryRunCreatedJob: A price check returned a job id; price checks are stopped for the session
types.RequestInFlight: A job with the same request is uploading, awaiting approval, being sent or `uncertain`; for `uncertain`, the person resolves it in Jobs first
types.UncertainNeedsPerson: Only the person can resolve an `uncertain` job
types.NotYourJob: Cancel, withdraw, stop or resume a job another client session or the person started
types.NoSpend: `SCENARIO_NO_SPEND=1` or No-spend mode refused a paid call or an upload
types.SpendDeclined: The person declined the approval card (reported in `job_status`)
types.UploadDeclined: The person declined the upload card
types.Blocked: Scenario's content policy blocked the request
types.ResultUnreachable: A result sits on a host the plugin's manifest does not declare; open it on Scenario. The job reads `download_failed`
types.ResultExpired: A result is no longer available on Scenario. The job reads `download_failed`
types.UploadRefused: The file was not chosen by the person or made by the plugin
types.UnsupportedDocument: Color mode or bit depth the lane cannot read
types.DocumentNotAllowed: Agents read the active document only is on and the call named another document
types.DocumentNotActive: A document change or `execute_batchplay` named a `document_id` that is not the active document. The message names no other document
types.DocumentChanged: The canvas changed since the capture
types.ApplicationExpired: `application_id` older than 10 minutes, or already applied
types.ApplicationUsed: `application_id` older than 10 minutes, or already applied
types.SwitchOff: A tool that needs a switch was called while it is off (except `apply_result_application`, which returns a proposal)
types.CommandRefused: `execute_batchplay` hit a descriptor outside the allow-list; the message gives its index and the reason
types.NotScenarioLayer: The layer carries no Scenario metadata
types.PhotoshopBusy: Another plugin or a dialog holds Photoshop's modal state for more than 10 s
types.Timeout: The tool call exceeded 120 s; the work continues and `job_status` reports it. For `generate`, call it again with the same `idempotency_key`
types.Internal: An unexpected error in the helper or the plugin; the message says what failed
